jobs.title: Senior Partner
jobs.description: About the Role A Germany-based legal technology company is seeking a Senior Partner to help grow an AI-enabled legal services practice. You will bring an established client portfolio, continue advising those clients, and work with the team to expand the use of AI in recurring legal work. What You'll Do Help shape the firm's growth and develop opportunities across your client network. Bring your portable client portfolio to the firm's technology platform and continue serving those clients. Build market credibility and generate opportunities through relationships with private equity, venture capital, and mid-market clients. Identify cross-selling opportunities for commercial and compliance services. Work with the team to transition recurring legal matters to AI-enabled workflows. What We're Looking For 12 to 20 or more years of German legal practice, with experience at partner level in a recognized law firm or boutique. A German-qualified Volljurist admitted as a Rechtsanwalt, with a portable book of business valued at €1 million or more. A broad client portfolio, ideally with private equity or venture capital relationships and recurring commercial, technology, data, corporate, or regulatory work. Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or legal AI tools, and a willingness to adapt legal workflows through automation. Native-level German and professional English. Ability to transition clients within a feasible timeframe and without restrictions that prevent client migration. Compensation & Benefits Base salary range: €200,000 to €300,000 annually. Equity is part of the opportunity. Visa sponsorship is not available. Location Based in Berlin, Germany. The role can be on-site or remote within Germany. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A, the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable, and abundant source of power globally. Your Role You will own Focused Energy's permitting and regulatory pathway across our regulated technical facilities, from early feasibility through construction, commissioning, and handover to Operations. You will build and run the integrated permitting strategy under the direction of the Senior Project Manager / Programme Director, and act as our primary contact with competent German authorities. Your work will ensure regulatory requirements shape design, procurement, and construction decisions, with a particular focus on the Biblis site transition and the evolving German fusion regulatory framework. What You'll Do Develop and maintain the integrated permitting strategy, including authority mapping, submission schedules, permit and conditions registers, and regulatory-risk forecasts. Lead coordinated engagement with municipal, district, Hessian state, and federal authorities, aligning submissions and commitments with the approved project strategy. Own permitting coordination for the Biblis nuclear-site transition, including RWE decommissioning interfaces, existing licences, radiation-protection arrangements, and handover evidence. Coordinate application readiness with Engineering, architects, fire-safety and structural specialists, and the Prüfstatiker, and track reviews to closure. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. The Compliance team at Payward plays a critical role in enabling the company to grow responsibly while navigating a rapidly evolving regulatory environment. Our teams work across jurisdictions and product lines to design and maintain scalable compliance frameworks that support Payward’s mission while ensuring regulatory obligations are met. The Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) Scale Team is responsible for ensuring the FIU can scale, across new operating jurisdictions and new products, effectively and efficiently. The team leads AML transaction monitoring and blockchain monitoring to ensure thresholds are appropriately set, tested, and governed while reducing false positives and maintaining strong oversight. jobs.title: Handler Certification Specialist
jobs.description: Who we are: CCOF advances organic agriculture for a healthy world. We advocate on behalf of our members for organic policies, support the growth of organic through education and grants, and provide organic certification that is personal and accessible. CCOF is a nonprofit organization governed by the people who grow and make our food. Founded in California in 1973, our roots now span the breadth of North America, and our presence is internationally recognized. We are supported by an organic family of farmers, ranchers, processors, retailers, consumers, and policymakers. Together, we work to realize a future where organic is the norm. Position Summary: CCOF is expanding our Handler Certification team! We are seeking a Handler Certification Specialist who will provide technical services to certify organic Handler operations and new applicants, ensuring all clients have fair and equal access to the certification process. If you have regulatory compliance and/or food industry experience and a passion for our mission to advance organic agriculture for a healthier world, we encourage you to apply. As a Handler Certification Specialist, you’ll play a key role in ensuring the organic integrity of products in the marketplace. This is a full-time, non-exempt position that reports to the Handler Certification Team Lead, Supervisor, or Manager. This is a United States-based remote position. This position does not include on-site inspections of certified operations and will not include fieldwork in the future. Applications will be reviewed beginning November 2, 2026, and will be accepted until November 13, 2026. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Legal Counsel PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk
jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk adalah sebuah badan usaha milik negara Indonesia yang menyediakan berbagai macam jasa keuangan. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Sampai dengan hari ini, Bank Mandiri meneruskan tradisi selama lebih dari 140 tahun memberikan kontribusi dalam dunia perbankan dan perekonomian Indonesia.
